system.one_liner: An analysis tracing loss explosion in low-precision Flash Attention training to low-rank representations and biased rounding errors, with a fix in safe softmax.

content.variant_note: a derivation chain of boxed claims with formulas: a three-box analysis column and a blue zoom panel that opens the middle box into the causal chain ending in loss explosion
content.argues: Loss explosion in low-precision flash attention traces back to biased rounding errors combined with similar low-rank representations; a dynamic maximum in safe softmax removes the bias.
content.subject: A map from paper sections to the causal chain from low-rank representations and biased rounding to loss explosion, and the fix.

evidence: Our paper traces the causal chain of training failure (blue box) in reverse to identify the root causes.
The full process of such failure from root cause to loss exploding is shown in Fig. 1.
the emergence of low-rank representations and the accumulation of biased rounding errors inherent to BF16 arithmetic

summary: This paper explains why training a transformer with flash attention in low precision makes the loss explode. Figure 1 maps the analysis onto the paper's sections. A left column of three section-tagged boxes joined by hollow down arrows reads: Section 3.2 isolates the failure source (the low-precision O in the delta computation, Claim 1), Section 3.3 finds the root cause, Section 4 mitigates the bias with a dynamic maximum in safe softmax. Two blue lines open the middle box into a light-blue zoom panel: similar low-rank representations (Claim 2, purple terms) and biased rounding error delta_lp − delta_hp (Claim 3, red terms) feed a gradient-error formula, which raises the spectral norm and ends in 'Loss Exploding!!!' with explosion emoji.
summary_zh: 低精度 Flash Attention 训练为何损失爆炸？图按章节展开：左侧三个带章节标签的框（定位失败来源、找根因、用安全 softmax 动态最大值纠偏），蓝色放大面板展开根因链：低秩表示与有偏舍入误差合成梯度误差，终致损失爆炸。
